## Simpson's Paradox

A clear introduction to one of the most counterintuitive results in statistics — when a trend that appears in grouped data reverses when the groups are combined.

::: {.ratio .ratio-16x9}
<iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/bArPxj5xhso" title="Simpson's paradox" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
